what: Instant-photo cards are scattered over a 3D plaster desk seen from above (a recessed plate with a rim around it). The camera sits at height 6.4 with a 32° field of view, shifts .2 toward the cursor and looks .28 that way (.85s power3.out). Hovering a card lifts it slightly over .4s thomas(.625,.05,0,1). Picking it up raises it .3 so it follows the hand (response 11.5) and tilts with the drag speed. Sweeping the cursor faster than 1000px/s makes cards within 160px of its path spin as if blown by wind (friction 2.75 · rotation 1.55), then after 5s they return to place over 1.8s thomas with a .18 stagger. Dropping a card into the recessed well at the bottom right makes it stick like a magnet within .42 of the well size radius (drop 1.6x · resistance .08), a glowing border breathes, and at .7s it slides into the well center and fires fx:open (unless prevented, then to that card’s link). A plain click flies to the well along the same path and opens. Intro: with full, it settles from a .65x zoom over 2.1s thomas and the cards drop at .07 intervals over .7s. With title: on, the lifted card’s name rises as large text on the floor behind the card over .3s

options.size · msize: Card width (ratio of screen width) — wide screens · phone (below 768px), default .104 · .29. Can be changed per card with data-size · data-msize
options.aspect: Card width/height ratio, default .8 (Polaroid) — data-aspect per card
options.parallax · look: Cursor parallax lag · viewer’s share, default .2 · .28
options.intro: now (appears instantly) · full (zoom settle + cards drop) · short (cards only) · wait (waits for fx:intro), default now
options.wind: If off, turns off the cursor wind
options.open: Duration of flying to the cell (sec), default .7
options.floor: plaster (plaster stains·cracks) · mat (grid static mat), default plaster
options.caption: hand (handwriting, centered) · sans (small sans-serif, left), default hand
options.title · title-x · title-y · title-size: When on, large card name text, position (panel ratio) · size scale, default off · .5 · .32 · .53
options.rim: Border rim width (ratio of short side), default .05

parts.card: <a href> — data-x·data-y (center on the panel ratio)·data-r (degrees, clockwise) · phone uses data-mx·data-my·data-mr · data-caption (text below the paper)·data-title (big name)·data-label (photo-slot description) · with data-well it sits inside the cell
parts.well: data-x · data-y · data-w · data-h (panel ratio), phones use data-mx…

events.fx:intro: Receiving: if detail.full is false only the card drops, and if detail.instant it stands immediately with no zoom or drop (with hold also given, only the desk stands, and the card and big name text come in when fx:reveal is received)
events.fx:reveal: Received — after standing with instant + hold, cards drop at .07 interval over .7s thomas and name letters float up over .3s
events.fx:intro-start: Dispatch — when the entrance starts detail.full·hold (when floating an item added to the same scene together)
events.fx:leave: Receive — cards float up and out at .05 intervals, .7s power2.in, and fire fx:left
events.fx:open: Dispatched (cancelable) — detail.href when a card lands in the slot
events.fx:card-hover: Sent — card with raised hand detail.index·title
events.fx:desk-ready: Handoff: el.kfDesk(THREE·scene·camera·renderer·toWorld·view·px·onFrame·well) lets you add objects to the same scene
events.fx:theme: Receiving — re-reads the color after the skin changes

note: Colors are --fx-floor (floor · lip, default --kf-surface) · --fx-paper (paper, --kf-raised) · --fx-photo · --fx-photo-ink · --fx-caption · --fx-glow (cell glow, --kf-accent) · --fx-title · --fx-edge (board edge shade, --kf-line). The amount the floor is pushed outside the board is exposed as --fx-desk-x and --fx-desk-y (px), so translating the floor text (HUD) by the same amount makes it look attached to the scene like the original. The original has its own WebGPU engine with physics contact, paper aging, GTAO and bloom, here only the same camera, light positions, parallax, wind and magnet cell values are carried over to three (WebGL) (no card-to-card collision). Card links are hidden only visually so they can still be opened with Tab · Enter. On phones (no hover), parallax and wind are off and only drag and press are accepted.
